title: Rosemary Beach "Mary Rose" 45 Abaco Lane Main and Carriage House
h1: Rosemary Beach "Mary Rose" 45 Abaco Lane Main and Carriage House
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to the Rosemary Beach Access and 4 neighborhood pools- Access to fitness center and racquet club- Private heated pool *Pool heating is available October 1–May 1 for $60 per day- Complimentary Peloton Bike- an Alaya exclusive amenity- Newly built in 2017 by Benecki Homes and designed by Melanie Turner Interiors - 8 adult bikes- Carriage house- Refreshing the living room furniture and the dining room table with Restoration Hardware pieces in Spring 2026- Complete Clean Linen Participant—ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Retreat to Mary Rose for idyllic days relaxing beside the shimmering private pool or sunbathing along the sprawling Gulf shore—only a 5-minute walk away. Accommodating 20 guests in unrivaled comfort, this Rosemary Beach property boasts 7 beautiful bedrooms and 6.5 bathrooms. For ultimate convenience, dedicated beach access, 4 neighborhood pools, a fitness center, boutiques, and restaurants are all within walking distance!Cypress beams, sparkling travertine floors, and a curated blend of coastal and contemporary aesthetics evoke the feel of a European retreat in the Main House, where guests can unwind on soft, modern furnishings. The deluxe kitchen was designed for large groups, featuring 2 dishwashers and 2 refrigerators. Savor shared meals at the table for 8, with additional seating for 4 at the marble waterfall island or indulge in an alfresco feast at the patio table. Afterward, relax on the outdoor sofa, and then stretch out on the poolside loungers while the gentle sound of the fountain feature chases worries away. This level’s guest bedroom offers an enchanting refuge with a 4-poster king bed, TV, and private bathroom.The second floor continues to impress with a cypress wood ceiling in the stunning primary bedroom, boasting a writing desk, TV, and balcony access. A guest bedroom with 2 full beds shares the balcony, while the final guest bedroom has a king bed. All the bedrooms on this level feature a private bathroom, and the convenient laundry room hosts 2 washers and dryers to keep beach towels fresh.The third floor promises indoor fun with a ping-pong table and spacious theater room, complete with cozy seating, a wet bar, and a 75” TV. Barn doors conceal 2 sleeping nooks—with 1 queen-over-queen bunk in the first, and 1 queen-over-queen bunk and 1 twin-over-twin bunk in the second.In the Carriage House, guests will find a secluded retreat featuring an open living and dining space, full kitchen, and a guest bedroom with a king bed. A twin daybed in the living area provides additional sleeping accommodations.Indulge in a luxury Rosemary Beach vacation at Mary Rose. On-site parking and 8 complimentary adult bikes make it easy to explore 30A. For beach access, use any of the community access points or the public access at the end of Winston Lane. Don't miss the opportunity to book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSFIRST FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub SeparateGuest Bedroom: Two Full Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR LOFT:Bunk Area: Queen-over-Queen Built-in Bunk bed and Twin-over-Twin Built-in Bunk bed together in a private room Queen-over-Queen Built-in Bunk bed in another private bedroom, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlyCARRIAGE HOUSE:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo
